text:
flo (events): Hey team — thinking of a low-key after-work hang this Tue. Options: 1) Tiki Rooftop (rooftop cocktails + small plates), 2) Corner Pub (drafts + arcade), 3) TinyTiles Game Lounge (board games + snacks). Which do you prefer? time 6:30 or 7:30? RSVP + any dietary stuff. :tropical_drink: :game_die:

jon: Tiki rooftop sounds lovely. 7:30 for me — I can grab a table if we have ~8 people. :+1:

mira: TinyTiles for me! Prefer quieter game place. Also vegetarian here — any menu recs? :leafy_green:

kevin: Corner Pub — quick walk home after. 6:30 works best. Cheap wings :)

sam: I'm +1 for Tiki but only if we can book a covered spot (rain check). 7:30 okay.

liz: Sorry team, traveling next week — can't make Tue. Have fun! :airplane:

flo (events): Cool — seems split. Quick poll made (vote below). If majority picks Tiki, I'll try to reserve roof seating for 8 at 7:30. If TinyTiles wins, I'll book two tables and ask about veg options. If Pub wins, I'll ask for a high-top near the arcade.

ops-bot: Poll: "Where should we go Tue night?" • Tiki Rooftop — 2 votes • Corner Pub — 1 vote • TinyTiles Game Lounge — 2 votes (ends in 12h)

mira: FYI I can bring a small veg platter if that's helpful. Also happy to run a quick board-game poll (party games or strategy?).

jon: Thanks Mira — that helps. If Tiki wins, veg platter would be great.

kevin: If Pub wins, I'll handle the wings order. :meat_on_bone:

flo (events): Lovely. I'll check weather/cover options for Tiki and post final plan ~tomorrow lunchtime. If you haven't voted, drop a quick emoji on the poll message or reply here. :sparkles:

sam: Marking tentative in calendar. See y'all then! :calendar:
